article: SOQLで日別のSalesforceレコード数を集計する方法
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, including SOQL syntax, aggregate semantics, date/time-zone behavior, titles/descriptions, and official reference links.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date and retained 2023-04-09 as publication date; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Changed grouping to DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) so daily boundaries use the running user’s time zone.
Used COUNT(Id) and stated that the result is the ten date groups with the highest counts, not the most recent ten days.
Explained that empty dates do not appear and a WHERE CreatedDate filter can restrict the period.
Replaced the Stack Overflow reference with official Salesforce documentation.

post/SalesforceのSOQLを利用して日別のレコード作成数を取得する.source: post/SalesforceのSOQLを利用して日別のレコード作成数を取得する方法/index.md
post/SalesforceのSOQLを利用して日別のレコード作成数を取得する.summary: Compared the complete Japanese article and twelve translations with current Salesforce SOQL documentation; corrected the query for user-time-zone day grouping and clarified that sorting returns the ten busiest days.

meaning.note: Compared what the query returns and clarified that LIMIT 10 with ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC yields the ten busiest date groups, not the ten most recent dates; empty dates do not appear.

terminology.note: Checked SOQL, Developer Console, API object name, CreatedDate, DAY_ONLY, convertTimezone, COUNT(Id), GROUP BY, ORDER BY, and running-user time zone in all language versions.

mathematics.note: Verified the aggregate count and grouping expression, and confirmed DAY_ONLY is applied to a DateTime field; convertTimezone makes the date grouping use the running user’s time zone.

code.note: Verified that the SOQL groups by the same DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) expression selected, counts Id, sorts by aggregate count descending, and limits results to ten groups.

links.note: Replaced the Stack Overflow-only reference with Salesforce Developers documentation for date functions, time-zone conversion, aggregate functions, and official Query Editor steps.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
The query was not executed in a Salesforce org; object permissions, API version, and org-specific data were not tested.
The ten returned groups are the most numerous date groups across the queried records; use a WHERE filter or a different sort when a different date range/order is intended.
